name: red yellow pepper pasta
instructions: Saute garlic in olive oil and butter. Add red and yellow bell pepper slivers and saute. Finish with minced basil at the end. Toss with pasta.
notes:
Marcella Hazan. It works really well (pass, 2026-11-20).

STUFFED PEPPERS KINSHIP: it reminds me of [[italian-stuffed-bell-peppers]] (duh) — which leads me to think it would be good with either crispy fried tofu, ground turkey, or egg (all in want_to_try).

PARMESAN (2026-11-20): parmesan also pairs well with this one — secondary.
